competences.description: Attacks the enemy to disturb HP recovery for 2 turns with a 60% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy target and 3 random enemies to provoke them for 1 turn with an 80% chance each. When the target is already provoked, the provocation duration increases by 1 turn, up to 3 turns.

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy target 2 times that deal damage proportionate to your MAX HP. The first hit increases the enemy's chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns, and the second hit resets the target's Attack Bar.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
